messages.content: [User Role: CUSTOMER]
Hi, I want to create a new customer account on Auxin. How do I register?

Welcome to Auxin! To create your customer account, open the app or website and head to the authentication page. Select the 'Sign Up' tab, choose 'Customer' as your role, enter your mobile phone number, and set a password. After submitting, you will receive a 6-digit OTP on your mobile number for verification. Once verified, your account is immediately ready for browsing and shopping fresh produce!
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
I tried signing up with my phone number +919876543210 but it says the number is already registered.

That message indicates an account already exists for +919876543210. You can switch to the 'Sign In' tab on the login screen and enter your password. If you forgot your password, tap 'Forgot Password?' to reset it via SMS OTP.
Oh, I might have created an account earlier. Let me try signing in instead.
Sounds good! Switch to the 'Sign In' tab, enter +919876543210 along with your password, and click 'Login'. If you run into any issues, just let me know.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
I didn't receive the SMS OTP for verifying my phone number. What should I do?

Please verify that your phone number was entered correctly with the proper country code (+91) and that your device has active cellular reception. Wait 60 seconds for the timer on the screen to complete, then tap 'Resend OTP'. If you still don't receive it, ensure DND (Do Not Disturb) settings on your mobile service provider are not blocking transaction messages.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
The app says my OTP expired when I entered 482910.
For security reasons, OTP codes on Auxin expire after 5 minutes. Since this code has expired, please tap the 'Resend OTP' button on your screen to receive a fresh 6-digit code via SMS.
Got the new code 918234. Where do I type it?

Enter 918234 into the six digit input boxes on your verification screen and click 'Verify OTP'. Once submitted, your mobile number will be verified and you will be redirected to complete your delivery profile.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Why does Auxin ask for a mobile number instead of an email for registration?

Milo — The AI Assistant for Auxin. Auxin uses mobile number authentication to ensure seamless communication, SMS order updates, and delivery handoff OTP verification. Behind the scenes, our system securely links your phone number to an account so you can log in quickly using just your phone number and password.
Can I add my email address later for receiving electronic invoices?

Yes, absolutely! Once you log in, navigate to your Account Settings or Profile tab, where you can add your personal email address. This email will be saved to your profile and used for sending digital receipts and order confirmations.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
I forgot my account password. How can I reset it?

To reset your password, go to the login screen and tap 'Forgot Password?'. Enter your registered mobile phone number (+91 format). We will send a 6-digit password reset OTP to your phone. Once you verify the OTP, you can enter a new password and log in to your account.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
I am setting up my customer profile. What delivery address details are required?

To ensure accurate doorstep delivery and precise geofencing for our couriers, please provide:
1. Flat/House No. and Building/Apartment Name
2. Street and Area Name (e.g. 10th Main, Koramangala)
3. City and State (e.g. Bengaluru, Karnataka)
4. 6-digit Pincode (e.g. 560034)
5. Map Pin/Location Permission (to capture your precise delivery latitude and longitude).
Why does Auxin need my GPS location for my delivery address?

Our delivery verification system uses geofencing to ensure that delivery partners are physically present within 500 meters of your delivery coordinates before completing the handoff OTP verification. This guarantees that your fresh produce is delivered right to your location.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Can I save multiple delivery addresses, like my home and office?

Yes, you can save multiple addresses in your profile under 'Saved Addresses'. You can tag each address as 'Home', 'Work', or 'Other', and set one as your default delivery address. During checkout, you can select which address to use for your order.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
If I refresh the browser or close the app, will I stay logged in?

Yes! Auxin maintains secure session persistence. Refreshing your browser or closing the app will keep you logged in. If your session token expires after a prolonged period of inactivity, you will be prompted to log back in for your account security.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Can you give me a tour of the Customer Dashboard?

Milo — The AI Assistant for Auxin. I'd be happy to guide you! The Customer Dashboard has four main sections:
1. **Home / Marketplace**: Browse standard produce, category filters, organic badges, and current availability.
2. **Search Bar**: Quick full-text search with instant category and organic filters.
3. **My Orders**: Track active deliveries, view handoff OTPs, order history, and status updates.
4. **Profile & Cart**: Manage saved addresses, wishlist items, and review your cart drawer.
Where do I see my active order delivery status?

Tap the 'My Orders' icon in the top or bottom navigation bar. Under 'Active Orders', you will see your order status (Pending, Accepted, Out for Delivery), courier details, and your 6-digit delivery handoff OTP.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What does 'From ₹40/kg' mean on a product card?

Auxin aggregates inventory from multiple local farmers for each master product (like Tomatoes or Potatoes). 'From ₹40/kg' indicates the best starting price available among all contributing farmers for that produce. Clicking on the product details will show you individual farmer listings, prices, organic certifications, and available stock.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How do I know if produce listed on Auxin is organic?
Look for the green 'Organic' badge on the product card. Farmers specify whether their inventory batch is certified organic when listing their harvest, including harvest dates and farming notes.
Can I filter the home page to only show organic products?
Yes! On the marketplace home screen or search page, toggle the 'Organic Only' filter switch. The page will immediately update to show only organic-certified fruits, vegetables, and herbs.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
I searched for 'Spinach' but got no results.

If searching for 'Spinach' yields no results, it means local farmers currently have zero active stock for spinach or existing batches have reached their 30-day harvest expiry. Try searching for related leafy greens like 'Coriander' or 'Methi', or check back tomorrow as farmers update their inventory daily after fresh morning harvests.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Can I search produce by price range?
Yes! Tap the search bar or filter icon on the marketplace header. You can set minimum and maximum price thresholds (e.g. ₹20 to ₹80) alongside category filters to find produce within your budget.
Does the search support Indian language produce names like 'Aloo' or 'Tamatar'?

Our server search supports full-text queries across product names, descriptions, and common local aliases. Searching for 'Potato' or 'Aloo', and 'Tomato' or 'Tamatar' will bring up the relevant master catalogue items.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What produce categories are available on Auxin?

Auxin organizes products into structured main categories and subcategories:
- **Vegetables**: Leafy Greens, Root Vegetables, Gourds, Beans & Pods
- **Fruits**: Tropical Fruits, Citrus, Berries, Seasonal Specialties
- **Grains & Pulses**: Rice, Wheat, Millets, Lentils
- **Dairy & Eggs**: Fresh Milk, Curd, Ghee, Paneer
- **Herbs & Spices**: Coriander, Mint, Ginger, Garlic, Turmeric
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How do I filter products under 'Dairy & Eggs'?

Tap on the 'Dairy & Eggs' category pill at the top of the marketplace home screen. The grid will instantly update to display fresh items like Cow Milk, Buffalo Milk, Farm Curd, Pure Ghee, and Fresh Paneer.
Are dairy items delivered fresh daily?
Yes! Local dairy farmers list fresh morning batches daily, with harvest/milking dates clearly displayed on each item card so you always receive farm-fresh dairy.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How does the Wishlist feature work?

You can tap the heart icon on any product card to add items to your Wishlist. Your Wishlist stores your favorite staple items (like weekly organic milk or tomatoes) so you can quickly add them to your cart during your next shopping session without searching.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
I added Alphonso Mangoes to my wishlist last week, but now it says out of stock.

Items in your wishlist display real-time stock aggregation across local farmers. If all farmers have sold out their current harvest batch, the item will show 'Out of Stock' until a farmer updates their inventory with fresh stock.
Will it automatically notify me when fresh stock is listed?
While in your Wishlist, items refresh automatically. We are also working on push notifications for stock restocks on your favorited items.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Why does the app prevent me from adding produce from two different farmers to the same cart?

To ensure hyper-fast, direct farm-to-doorstep fulfillment, Auxin V3.0 pairs each order directly with a single farmer and local courier. All items in your cart must come from the same farmer. If you select produce from a different farmer, you will be prompted to complete your current order first or start a new cart.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How do I increase the quantity of carrots in my cart?

Open the Cart drawer by tapping the cart icon in the top right. Next to 'Carrots', use the '+' button to increase the quantity (e.g. from 1 kg to 2 kg). The total price will automatically recalculate based on the farmer's unit pricing.
It won't let me increase beyond 15 kg.
The maximum quantity you can add is limited by the farmer's remaining available stock. If the farmer currently has only 15 kg of carrots in stock, the cart will cap your selection at 15 kg.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What payment options are available at checkout?

Auxin supports two secure payment methods:
1. **Online Payment (Razorpay Escrow)**: Pay via Credit/Debit Card, Netbanking, UPI, or Wallets. Payment is held securely in escrow until delivery is verified.
2. **Cash on Delivery (COD)**: Pay the delivery partner directly in cash upon receiving your produce and validating your delivery OTP.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What is the Escrow payment protection I see during checkout?

Milo — The AI Assistant for Auxin. Escrow protection means your payment is safely held by Auxin and NOT released to the farmer until you physically receive your fresh produce and provide the 6-digit delivery OTP to the courier. If there is an issue or cancellation, your money can be refunded easily.
Where do I find my delivery OTP after paying?

Once your payment is complete and your order is accepted, your 6-digit OTP will be displayed under 'Active Orders' in the app and sent to your registered phone number. Show this OTP to the delivery partner when they arrive at your door.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How does Auxin guarantee farm-fresh quality?

Auxin connects you directly to local nearby farms without middleman warehouses. Farmers post harvest dates for every batch, and orders are fulfilled directly from the farm to your doorstep using local delivery partners. You can view harvest dates, organic status, and farmer locations right on the product page!
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
I accidentally selected 'Farmer' role during registration. Can I change it to Customer?

Roles are assigned during registration to establish appropriate security and database permissions. Since Farmer accounts require administrative approval, please contact our support or register a fresh account selecting the 'Customer' role with your phone number.
Okay, I will re-register as Customer. Thank you!
You're welcome! Make sure to select 'Customer' on the signup tab, and you'll have instant access to browse and purchase fresh produce.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How is the delivery fee calculated for my order?

The delivery fee is calculated based on the distance between the farmer's location and your delivery address coordinate. At checkout, Auxin computes the distance and displays the transparent delivery charge before you confirm payment.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
